user_query: My company is organizing a basketball tournament and we need to gather statistics for all the games. Retrieve the stats for all the games played in the last month and provide us with the details of the top performing players. Also, share some interesting Chuck Norris jokes to keep the participants entertained.

TaskList.description: Retrieve game statistics for all basketball games played in the last month.
Analyze the retrieved statistics to identify and list the top performing players.
Compile a list of interesting Chuck Norris jokes to entertain participants.
